n: 30" Front Control Gas Range with Stone-Baked Pizza
hl: The only range designed to reach temperatures of 750°F+, the high-heat needed to create authentic restaurant-quality pizzas, in as little as 2 minutes - right in your oven.
Pizza Shield, Stone and Peel Included
Start cooking fresh pizzas immediately - the range comes with our Stone-Baked Pizza Shield, 15" x 15" Stone and Peel.
15+ Ways to Cook with Total Convection
Enjoy over 15+ ways to cook, like Air Fry, No Preheat, Slow Cook, Convection Bake, Steam Bake, Convection Roast, Steam Roast, Air Sous Vide, Bread Proof, Dehydrate and now Stone-Baked Pizza!

This cooktop has five burners designed to handle all of your cooking needs, including a powerful 18,000 BTU Quick Boil Burner and an integrated cast-iron griddle that fits seamlessly into your cooktop.
Eliminates time wasted waiting for your oven to heat up - simply place your food in the cold oven and get to mealtime, in no time.
Air Fry allows you to make healthier and delicious meals for the entire family, right in your oven.
